processing_steps.method: Charge iron powder and ferrous oxalate in an alumina crucible, place in tubular furnace, and heat to 1873 K
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Iron powder (700 g) and ferrous oxalate (FeC2O4·H2O, 1.575 g) placed in an alumina crucible.
225 g ferromanganese added and held for 20 min.

processing_steps.method: Add aluminum particles wrapped in pure iron sheet
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: 28 g aluminum particles (second group; 2# sample) wrapped in pure iron sheet and held for 60 min.

processing_steps.method: Cool to room temperature in tubular furnace (furnace cooling)
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Final state is furnace-cooled (as-cast) solid steel.

structures.overall_structure: As-cast Fe-15Mn-3Al-C (2#, Al = 2.766%) low-density steel containing non-metallic inclusions: single-particle AlN, MnS, TiN and composite Al2O3-MnS, AlN-MnS, Al2O3-AlN-MnS, TiN-MnS.

phases_present.morphology: single elongated, facetted particle ≈23 μm; also occurs in AlN-MnS and Al2O3-AlN-MnS composites
octahedron single particle; forms composites with Al2O3, AlN and TiN

phases_present.crystal_structure: cubic, a=b=c=4.242 Å (printed with MnS subscripts in source table)

phases_present.morphology: black core in Al2O3-MnS composite; inner core in Al2O3-AlN-MnS composite

precipitates.distribution: single particle shaped like a boot
black Al2O3 core with gray MnS
close binding between MnS and AlN
Al2O3 inner, AlN middle, MnS outer (from inside out)
composite inclusion of TiN and MnS

defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: Al2O3, AlN, and TiN could provide nucleation sites for MnS; Al2O3 could also provide heterogeneous nucleation sites for AlN.

interfaces.phase_evolution: Precipitation order of single-particle inclusions: Al2O3 > AlN > MnS > TiN; later-formed inclusions nucleate and grow at heterogeneous nucleation sites of earlier-formed inclusions.
interfaces.interface_notes: Close binding relationship between MnS and AlN inclusions; interfacial relationship between MnS and TiN inclusions observed.

characterization_methods.technique: chemical analysis (carbon sulfur analyzer and ICP-MS)
characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: carbon sulfur analyzer for C, S, T.O, T.N; inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry for Al, Si, Ti, Mn, P
characterization_methods.purpose: Detect the chemical composition of the three experimental steels

characterization_methods.technique: field-emission scanning electron microscopy (FE-SEM) with energy dispersive spectrometer (EDS)
characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: ZEISS ΣIGMA HD FE-SEM; Oxford-X-Max 50 mm² EDS
characterization_methods.purpose: Observe the morphology and type of inclusions in the 2# sample
characterization_methods.key_findings: 2# inclusions: single AlN ≈23 μm (elongated, facetted), MnS octahedron, TiN boot-shaped; composites Al2O3-MnS (black Al2O3 core, gray MnS), AlN-MnS (close binding), Al2O3-AlN-MnS (Al2O3 inner, AlN middle, MnS outer), TiN-MnS.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: automatic inclusion analysis system, detection area 52 mm²
characterization_methods.purpose: Detect the size, type, and number of inclusions
characterization_methods.key_findings: 2# inclusion size distribution: 53.6% (1-5 μm), 34.6% (5-10 μm), 11.8% (>10 μm).

characterization_methods.purpose: Calculate solidification route, liquidus and solidus temperatures of the samples
characterization_methods.key_findings: 2# liquidus 1740 K, solidus 1560 K; solidification route L → L+BCC → L+BCC+FCC → L+FCC → FCC.

characterization_methods.purpose: Determine the solidification fractions at which AlN, TiN, and MnS inclusions precipitate
characterization_methods.key_findings: For 2#: AlN precipitates at solidification fraction 0.22; TiN at 0.93; MnS at 0.81.

characterization_methods.purpose: Assess heterogeneous nucleation effectiveness between inclusions
characterization_methods.key_findings: Mismatch degrees: Al2O3/MnS 8.41%, AlN/MnS 8.94%, TiN/MnS 11.65%, AlN/Al2O3 11.66%.

computational_details.simulation_method: CALPHAD phase diagram calculation using FactSage 8.2 phase diagram module for the Fe-C-Si-Mn-P-S-Al-O-N-Ti system
Clyne-Kurz microsegregation model combined with thermodynamic equilibrium (logK vs logQ intersection)
computational_details.boundary_and_initial_conditions: Initial composition of 2# (Table 2); T0 = 1809 K; cooling rate R_C; equilibrium distribution coefficients k and diffusion coefficients D from Table 5.

analytical_models.equation_role: Calculate element contents at solidification front: C_L = C0[1-(1-2Ωk)z_s]^((k-1)/(1-2Ωk))
analytical_models.model_note: Equilibrium distribution coefficients k and diffusion coefficients D taken from Table 5; interaction coefficients from Table 4.
Lattice parameters from Table 6; detailed interface calculation results in Table 7.

unmapped_findings: Al2O3-AlN-MnS inclusions exist in 1# and 2# samples but were not observed in the 3# sample. [b0032]
